name: Zalando RESTful API Guidelines
description: Style rules based on Zalando RESTful API Guidelines

rules.title: Provide API title
rules.rationale: API must have a clear, descriptive title.

rules.title: Provide API description
rules.rationale: API must have a description explaining its purpose.

rules.title: Provide contact information
rules.rationale: API should include contact information for support.

rules.title: Provide x-api-id extension
rules.rationale: Zalando APIs should have a unique API identifier.

rules.title: Provide x-audience extension
rules.rationale: APIs should declare their intended audience (external-public, external-partner, company-internal, component-internal).

rules.title: Define security schemes
rules.rationale: APIs must define their security requirements.

rules.title: Use OAuth2
rules.rationale: Prefer OAuth2 for authentication.

judge.prompt: Check if the API uses OAuth2 security scheme. API key alone is not recommended for production APIs.

rules.title: Do not break backward compatibility
rules.rationale: Changes must be backward compatible unless version is incremented.

judge.prompt: This is an advisory rule. Check if the API design allows for backward-compatible evolution: optional new fields, additive changes only.

rules.title: Use semantic versioning
rules.rationale: API versions should follow semantic versioning.

rules.title: Mark deprecated fields
rules.rationale: Deprecated fields should be marked with deprecated: true.

judge.prompt: Check if any deprecated functionality is properly marked with the 'deprecated' field in OpenAPI.

rules.title: Use snake_case for property names
rules.rationale: Property names must use snake_case.

rules.title: Use ISO 8601 for dates
rules.rationale: Date and time values must use ISO 8601 format.

judge.prompt: Check if date/time properties use format: 'date-time' or 'date' (ISO 8601). Look for properties named *_at, *_time, *_date.

rules.title: Use standard time zone (UTC)
rules.rationale: Time values should be in UTC.

judge.prompt: Check if the API documentation indicates that timestamps are in UTC. This should be mentioned in field descriptions or API overview.

rules.title: Use standard duration format
rules.rationale: Durations should use ISO 8601 duration format (PnYnMnDTnHnMnS).

judge.prompt: Check if duration fields use ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., PT1H30M) rather than numeric seconds/milliseconds.

rules.title: Use null for empty values
rules.rationale: Use null for absent values, not empty strings or special values.

judge.prompt: Check if nullable properties are properly marked with nullable: true in OpenAPI 3.0+. Avoid empty strings as placeholders.

rules.title: Use standard HTTP methods
rules.rationale: Use standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) appropriately.

judge.prompt: Check if HTTP methods are used correctly: GET for retrieval, POST for creation, PUT/PATCH for updates, DELETE for removal. No CRUD operations via query parameters.

rules.title: Use standard status codes
rules.rationale: Use appropriate HTTP status codes for responses.

judge.prompt: Check if responses use appropriate status codes: 200/201 for success, 400 for bad requests, 401/403 for auth errors, 404 for not found, 500 for server errors.

rules.title: Use 201 for successful POST
rules.rationale: Successful POST that creates a resource should return 201 Created.

rules.title: Use 204 for successful DELETE
rules.rationale: Successful DELETE should return 204 No Content.

rules.title: Use lowercase in URLs
rules.rationale: URLs must be lowercase.

rules.title: Use hyphens in URLs
rules.rationale: Use hyphens (kebab-case) for multi-word path segments.

rules.title: Use plural resource names
rules.rationale: Resource collection names should be plural.

judge.prompt: Check if collection resource names are plural: /orders not /order, /customers not /customer.

rules.title: No trailing slashes
rules.rationale: URLs should not have trailing slashes.

rules.title: Use standard headers
rules.rationale: Use standard HTTP headers where applicable.

judge.prompt: Check if the API uses standard headers appropriately: Content-Type, Accept, Authorization, Location, etc. Custom headers should use X- prefix.

rules.title: Support Content-Type negotiation
rules.rationale: APIs should document supported content types.

rules.title: Use cursor-based pagination
rules.rationale: Prefer cursor-based pagination over offset-based.

judge.prompt: Check if collection endpoints support pagination. Cursor-based (using 'cursor' or 'after' parameter) is preferred over offset-based (page, offset).

rules.title: Support limit parameter
rules.rationale: Collection endpoints should support a 'limit' parameter.

judge.prompt: Check if collection endpoints support a 'limit' or 'page_size' parameter to control response size.

rules.title: Use HATEOAS
rules.rationale: Consider including hypermedia links for discoverability.

judge.prompt: Check if responses include hypermedia links (_links or links property) for related resources and actions.

rules.title: Include self link
rules.rationale: Resources should include a 'self' link.

judge.prompt: Check if resource responses include a 'self' link pointing to the resource's own URL.
